name: CI-never-let-go
note: Idle city workers stand for as long as the player is in the city's reach.

name: CI-old-idle-counted
note: An idle sent before the worker heard its latest want lets it go with that want unmade.

name: CI-need-out-ignored
note: The workers let go while a build waits on a piece they were asked for.

name: CI-alive-false-when-let-go
note: After an idle release the stream stops waiting and makes the city's pieces on the page's thread.

name: CI-nothing-told
note: A worker made again remakes every piece of the wanted slices.

name: CI-want-not-said-again
old: if (lastSlices.length) post(worker, { t: 'want', slices: shareOf(worker, lastSlices) });
note: A worker made again makes nothing ahead until the player crosses a slice.

name: CI-need-not-standing
note: A need after an idle release asks no worker: the stream waits for ever.

name: CI-want-not-standing
note: A new want after an idle release asks no worker: the slices ahead wait for a need.

name: CI-page-pieces-not-done
note: A piece the page made is made again by a worker made after an idle release.

name: CI-done-unheard
note: The worker ignores what was made before it stood.
